'''Loronar''' was the headquarters of [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Corporation]] and the site of the [[Loronar shipyards]] and protected by the [[Loronar navy]].

==History==
Like its neighbor [[Byblos/Legends|Byblos]], Loronar was colonized by [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] settlers before the founding of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Both worlds later declared their independence from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:Rogue_Squadron_Jade_Moon_2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] above the [[Jade Moon]], with Loronar in background.]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Battle of the Jade Moon|attacked]] one of the small bases on the [[Jade Moon]] during a raid. Using the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing Starfighter]], [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] provided air support for [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine's]] commando unit. The raid destroyed a small base used for critical Imperial operations.<ref name="SWRS">[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']]</ref>

By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the planet had become an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]].<ref name="TEA" />

Loronar joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] after its liberation and contributed to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] by producing [[Starship/Legends|starships]] for the New Republic.<ref name="TEGtW" />
